priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield, Flametongue Weapon, and Thunderstrike Ward at all times.
Cast Stormkeeper during pre-combat and whenever Ascendance has more than 10 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Use Ascendance whenever Stormkeeper has more than 15 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Use Ancestral Swiftness and Nature's Swiftness on cooldown.
Use offensive racials and trinkets, ideally synchronized with Ascendance or Stormkeeper windows.
Cast Flame Shock or Voltaic Blaze if the DoT is expiring and you do not currently have the Master of the Elements buff.
Cast Lava Burst to generate Maelstrom or on Lava Surge procs, only if you do not have the Master of the Elements buff.
Cast Tempest if you have the Master of the Elements buff active.
Cast Lightning Bolt if Stormkeeper is active and you have the Master of the Elements buff active.
Spend Maelstrom on Elemental Blast to avoid capping and to apply or extend Lightning Rod.
Spend Maelstrom on Earth Shock if Elemental Blast is unavailable to prevent capping.
Cast Tempest whenever it is available if not used during Master of the Elements windows.
Use Lightning Bolt as your primary filler spell.
Use Spiritwalker's Grace if you need to move for more than 6 yards.
If moving and Spiritwalker's Grace is unavailable, use instant casts like Voltaic Blaze or Frost Shock.
